dependencies_note: Catalog dependency IMP-0442 (dispatcher) is not delivered on this tree. Provisioner and teardown are self-contained over fixture repos and do not require the dispatcher.

downstream_consumers.note: G-1 measure runs after this receipt and the per-unit manifest exist.

evidence.claim: Squash-merge fixture: a fully-merged feature branch reports AHEAD. Content route SAFE, ancestry route UNSAFE. Production teardown follows content, not ancestry, and execute=True removes the fixture worktree. Two concurrently provisioned shards have disjoint git indexes; staging in one does not appear in the other.

Unproven teardown: unique dirty bytes on main, no PR, execute=True is refused (UNPROVEN_TEARDOWN) and the canary file remains on disk. Ancestry would have authorized delete (EQUAL on main) — the wrong answer. Harvesting the same bytes into a preserve store authorizes via content. A MERGED PR authorizes even when content is still unique. An OPEN PR carrying ancestry-shaped fields does not.

negative_controls.description: On the squash-merge fixture the content route authorizes and the ancestry route refuses. Production matches content. A mutant that ORed ancestry.would_authorize_delete would still pass this fixture (ancestry is False here) and is caught by C2.
Dirty worktree on main: ancestry would_authorize_delete=True (the data-loss mutant). Production refuses. execute=True leaves the canary. Harvesting the unique bytes is the good twin.
negative_controls.good_state_output: harvested unique bytes authorized via content-digest

notes: G-1 for IMP-0446. Ancestry is recorded beside every teardown decision and is never an authorization input. SENTINEL:IMP-0446:TEARDOWN-CONTENT-PROVEN
question_or_target: Implement disposable worktree provisioning per implementation shard (spec line 10581) and a teardown that refuses to delete until the shard's content is proven preserved elsewhere. Exact target: because squash-merge makes a fully-merged branch report as AHEAD, commit ancestry must NOT be accepted as delete authorization — require merged-PR state or a byte-level content comparison.

residual_unknowns.claim: No live GitHub merged-PR was consulted; the MERGED-PR route is proven against a structured pr_state fixture. Wiring to a host PR API is out of scope for this unit.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Point merged_pr_proof at a recorded gh pr view JSON for a known squash-merged PR and re-run probe2.

retry.policy: no automatic retry; an incorrect teardown is unrecoverable data loss

reviewer.notes: Catalog reviewer_requirement is 2 independent reviewers plus owner approval before any REAL teardown. Fixture-only teardowns ran inside TemporaryDirectory repos tagged .imp0446-fixture. The host worktree was not torn down.

title: Worktree-per-shard provisioner with content-preserving teardown
